intro.title: Your agents, with clear permissions
intro.body: Connect any MCP-compatible client to look up documentation, create tasks and reorganize boards. Each token belongs to a single workspace and can only do what you allow.
intro.oauth: In Claude (web, desktop and mobile), add a custom connector with this endpoint. No token needed: you’ll be asked for permission here. Any client that supports OAuth works the same way.

vault.title: The vault is out of their reach
vault.unreadable: No token can read the vault, not even encrypted: the server rejects the request before it touches any data.
vault.noDeletes: Agents can’t delete anything. They can only archive, and you can restore.
vault.logged: Every action is logged, and you can watch it live in the app.

tokens.emptyTitle: You haven’t connected any agents yet
tokens.emptyBody: Create a token and paste the configuration into Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code or Claude Desktop.

activity.title: Agent activity
activity.empty: When an agent works in this workspace, you’ll see it here.

tools.title: MCP tools
tools.footnote: Each agent only sees the tools its permissions allow.

descriptions.writePages: Create and update, with version control

revoke.title: Revoke “{{name}}”?
revoke.description: The agent loses access right away. Its past activity is kept.

oauth.computer: Connected with OAuth · returns to {{name}} on this computer
oauth.app: Connected with OAuth · returns to the “{{name}}” app on this computer

access.atLeastOne: Give read access to at least one area.

kit.desktopNote: Claude Desktop uses the mcp-remote bridge (Node.js) to send the authentication header.
kit.httpNote: Streamable HTTP transport with Bearer authentication. Restart the client if it doesn’t find the server.

create.description: Create a token for “{{workspace}}”. It can only reach this workspace, and only what you allow here.
create.descriptionFallback: Create a token for this workspace. It can only reach this workspace, and only what you allow here.

created.title: “{{name}}” is ready
created.description: Copy the token now. For security, we only keep its fingerprint, so you won’t be able to see it again.
